title: Game industry act faces major revisions
desc: The draft amendment of the Game Industry Promotion Act is back to square one as it faces major revisions, raising concerns over further delays to the law's implementation.

summary_cn: 泰国《游戏产业促进法》修订草案进度受阻，需进行重大调整，现已回到立法初期阶段。法律多次延期实施引发业界担忧。该法案目的是规范游戏产业发展、促进泰国数字产业增长。反复修订反映出政府、产业和监管部门在法案细节上存在分歧。

title: Luxury travel demand boosts hotels in Southeast Asia
desc: Southeast Asia remains a growth pillar for luxury travel amid the ongoing Middle East crisis as more travellers shift to the region, including Thailand, viewing it as a safe haven, according to global hospitality brand Accor.
title_cn: 奢华旅游需求推动东南亚酒店业增长
summary_cn: 全球酒店集团雅高(Accor)数据显示，受中东地缘政治局势影响，国际游客转向东南亚，将该地区视为安全旅游目的地。泰国作为东南亚主要旅游枢纽，因高端游客涌入而酒店业受益明显。这一趋势为泰国旅游业、酒店和相关服务业带来增长机遇，也反映出国际社会对泰国安全稳定的认可。
desc_original: Southeast Asia remains a growth pillar for luxury travel amid the ongoing Middle East crisis as more travellers shift to the region, including Thailand, viewing it as a safe haven, according to global hospitality brand Accor.

title: Eppo advances EV use in state sector
desc: The Energy Policy and Planning Office (Eppo) has laid out a roadmap to introduce electric vehicles (EVs) and charging stations across government agencies, describing it as a crucial step towards clean energy and the country's net-zero emissions target.
title_cn: 泰国推进政府部门电动车普及计划
summary_cn: 泰国能源政策规划办公室(Eppo)制定路线图，计划在全国政府机构推广电动汽车和充电基础设施。这被列为泰国实现清洁能源转型和碳中和目标的关键举措。政府部门率先采购电动车，不仅推动公共交通绿色升级，还将带动汽车产业链发展，扩大本地新能源产业规模。
desc_original: The Energy Policy and Planning Office (Eppo) has laid out a roadmap to introduce electric vehicles (EVs) and charging stations across government agencies, describing it as a crucial step towards clean energy and the country's net-zero emissions target.

desc: Thailand's industrial systems and seasoned workforce are its strongest competitive advantages as companies look to diversify production across Southeast Asia.
title_cn: 泰国产业深度成就区域竞争优势
summary_cn: 跨国企业在东南亚寻求生产多元化之际，泰国完善的产业体系和技能娴熟的劳动力成为其最强竞争力。泰国制造业产业链完整、产业配套齐全、技术积累深厚，是跨国公司理想的生产基地。这一优势有利于吸引制造业投资，巩固泰国作为东南亚制造业枢纽的地位。
desc_original: Thailand's industrial systems and seasoned workforce are its strongest competitive advantages as companies look to diversify production across Southeast Asia.

title: Ageing Thais put pressure on creaking pension system
desc: Thailand's social security system is becoming increasingly inadequate to support its rapidly ageing population, with people over 60 projected to account for a third of the population over the next 25 years, according to Kiatnakin Phatra Financial Group (KKP).
title_cn: 老龄化挑战泰国养老金制度
summary_cn: 泰国人口老龄化加剧，社会保障体系不堪重负。根据 Kiatnakin Phatra 金融集团预测，未来25年内60岁以上人口将占全国人口三分之一，现有养老金制度将面临巨大财政压力。这一人口结构变化对国家养老金体系的可持续性构成严峻挑战，需要启动系统性改革。
desc_original: Thailand's social security system is becoming increasingly inadequate to support its rapidly ageing population, with people over 60 projected to account for a third of the population over the next 25 years, according to Kiatnakin Phatra Financial Group (KKP).

title: Committee greenlights TAT's proposals
desc: The National Tourism Policy Committee has approved the Tourism Authority of Thailand's (TAT) proposal to seek visa exemptions for Mexican and Colombian visitors staying for under 30 days, while also endorsing the fourth National Tourism Development Plan, which targets 4 trillion baht in tourism revenue in 2032 and a top-30 ranking in the global Travel & Tourism Development Index (TTDI).
title_cn: 泰国旅游局提案获批，墨西哥等国将享免签待遇
summary_cn: 国家旅游政策委员会批准泰国旅游局 (TAT) 的两项重要提案。其一为墨西哥和哥伦比亚游客提供30天内免签便利；其二通过第四个国家旅游发展计划，目标2032年旅游收入达4万亿泰铢，力争跻身全球旅游竞争力排名前30。这些举措旨在吸引更多国际游客和提升泰国旅游产业竞争力。
desc_original: The National Tourism Policy Committee has approved the Tourism Authority of Thailand's (TAT) proposal to seek visa exemptions for Mexican and Colombian visitors staying for under 30 days, while also endorsing the fourth National Tourism Development Plan, which targets 4 trillion baht in tourism revenue in 2032 and a top-30 ranking in the global Travel & Tourism Development Index (TTDI).

title: Analysts see benefits from US midterms
desc: Today's US midterm elections could benefit Thailand and global trade, as stronger checks and balances between Congress and President Donald Trump could reduce US policy uncertainty and ease market volatility, analysts say.
title_cn: 美国中期选举利好全球贸易
summary_cn: 经济分析师普遍看好美国中期选举对泰国和全球贸易的拉动作用。国会制衡下的政策不确定性有望大幅下降，市场波动相应缓解，为出口导向的泰国提供更加稳定清晰的国际贸易预期，利好东南亚新兴市场的经济增长。
desc_original: Today's US midterm elections could benefit Thailand and global trade, as stronger checks and balances between Congress and President Donald Trump could reduce US policy uncertainty and ease market volatility, analysts say.

title: Solar scheme promises savings, but at what cost?
desc: The government's Solar for the People scheme offers households subsidies of up to 50,000 baht to install solar power systems, but consumers should weigh installation costs, eligibility requirements and potential savings before signing up.
title_cn: 「人民太阳能」计划补贴丰厚但需谨慎评估
summary_cn: 泰国政府推出「人民太阳能」补贴计划，为合格家庭最高补助5万泰铢用于太阳能系统安装。尽管该计划承诺长期电费节省，消费者在报名前仍需谨慎评估实际安装成本、个人资格要求和本地真实节能收益等因素，避免盲目跟风。
desc_original: The government's Solar for the People scheme offers households subsidies of up to 50,000 baht to install solar power systems, but consumers should weigh installation costs, eligibility requirements and potential savings before signing up.

title: Graft claims cast doubt on solar scheme
desc: The People's Party has called for an investigation into alleged irregularities in the government's 50-billion-baht household solar scheme, including suspected collusion among contractors and alleged kickbacks of 30,000 baht per installation.
title_cn: 「人民太阳能」计划被指贪腐，人民党要求彻查
summary_cn: 泰国人民党要求调查政府500亿泰铢「人民太阳能」方案涉嫌的贪腐问题，包括承包商之间可能存在的勾结串通以及每个安装项目涉嫌3万泰铢的回扣。该事件引发外界对计划合规性、廉政建设和资金去向的广泛关注和质疑。
desc_original: The People's Party has called for an investigation into alleged irregularities in the government's 50-billion-baht household solar scheme, including suspected collusion among contractors and alleged kickbacks of 30,000 baht per installation.

title: Roblox chooses Thailand for AI game developer launch
desc: Thailand is one of four countries selected by Roblox for the initial rollout of Build, an artificial intelligence-powered game creation tool, as the company taps local creativity to help more users develop games and pursue commercial opportunities on its platform.
title_cn: Roblox 在泰国启动 AI 游戏开发者工具
summary_cn: 泰国成为 Roblox 选中的四个国家之一，将推出 AI 游戏创作工具 Build，帮助更多用户开发游戏并在平台上获取商业机会。该项目将发掘本地创意，促进游戏产业发展。
desc_original: Thailand is one of four countries selected by Roblox for the initial rollout of Build, an artificial intelligence-powered game creation tool, as the company taps local creativity to help more users develop games and pursue commercial opportunities on its platform.

title: Cabinet to weigh B78.5bn development plan for Isan
desc: The mobile cabinet meeting in Udon Thani on Tuesday will consider 170 development projects worth more than 78.5 billion baht, covering agriculture, border trade, tourism and drug suppression across five northeastern provinces.
title_cn: 泰国政府审议伊桑地区 78.5 亿泰铢发展计划
summary_cn: 泰国政府流动内阁将在乌隆府 Udon Thani 召开会议，审议涉及 170 个发展项目的 78.5 亿泰铢投资计划。该计划覆盖农业、边境贸易、旅游和毒品防控等领域，涵盖东北地区五个省份，旨在推动区域经济发展。
desc_original: The mobile cabinet meeting in Udon Thani on Tuesday will consider 170 development projects worth more than 78.5 billion baht, covering agriculture, border trade, tourism and drug suppression across five northeastern provinces.

title: Amnesty clause may aid Thaksin's bid for B46bn

desc_original: A clause in the new amnesty law could give former prime minister Thaksin Shinawatra a route to challenge convictions and seek the return of 46 billion baht in seized assets, a political scientist has warned.

title: Experts urge deeper ties with Japan

summary_cn: 泰日双方专家呼吁两国深化在先进制造、清洁能源和数字基础设施等战略领域的合作，以增强区域竞争力和经济韧性。该倡议旨在推动双边经济关系发展，增强应对地区挑战的能力。
desc_original: Experts on Thai-Japan relations say Japan and Thailand should deepen cooperation in advanced manufacturing, clean energy and digital infrastructure to strengthen regional competitiveness and economic resilience.

title: PP targets corruption, economic failures
desc: The opposition has accused the government of monopolising political power, exploiting public funds and failing to address economic pressures and flooding ahead of a proposed censure debate.

summary_cn: 泰国反对党指责政府垄断权力、挪用公共资金，且未能有效应对经济压力和洪灾问题。反对党计划发起对政府的弹劾辩论，将腐败、经济失利和灾害应对列为主要批评焦点。
desc_original: The opposition has accused the government of monopolising political power, exploiting public funds and failing to address economic pressures and flooding ahead of a proposed censure debate.

title: Ministry widens crackdown on industrial waste
desc: The Industry Ministry will inspect 3,049 factories nationwide that handle industrial waste disposal and recycling, aiming to bring them up to standard within a year, Industry Minister Varawut Silpa-archa said.
title_cn: 工业部扩大产业废弃物整治力度
summary_cn: 泰国工业部宣布将对全国3049家处理工业废料的工厂进行专项检查，目标在一年内使这些企业的废料处理和回收流程达到国家标准，进一步规范产业废弃物管理。
desc_original: The Industry Ministry will inspect 3,049 factories nationwide that handle industrial waste disposal and recycling, aiming to bring them up to standard within a year, Industry Minister Varawut Silpa-archa said.

title: PP urges migrant labour management reforms
desc: People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has condemned an attack on a migrant workers' protest leader, calling for reforms to ease registration burdens and curb corruption.
title_cn: 人民党呼吁改革外劳管理制度
summary_cn: 人民党领导人Natthaphong谴责针对移工抗议领导人的暴力事件，呼吁政府改革外劳注册制度、减少行政负担、打击腐败，更好地保护外来劳动力的权益和安全。
desc_original: People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has condemned an attack on a migrant workers' protest leader, calling for reforms to ease registration burdens and curb corruption.

title: PP urges govt to promote domestic gaming industry
desc: People's Party MP Pawoot Pongvitayapanu has urged the government to support Thai-owned game development, saying Thailand must capture more value from its 37-billion-baht gaming market.

summary_cn: 人民党议员敦促政府加大对泰国本土游戏开发商的支持力度，指出泰国游戏市场规模达370亿铢，本土企业应从中获取更多价值并提升国际竞争力。
desc_original: People's Party MP Pawoot Pongvitayapanu has urged the government to support Thai-owned game development, saying Thailand must capture more value from its 37-billion-baht gaming market.

title: Chinese passenger caught with 8,900 weight loss pens at Suvarnabhumi Airport
desc: Chinese passenger caught with 8,900 weight loss pens at Suvarnabhumi Airport Legacy Customs officers at Suvarnabhumi International Airport seized 8,900 illegal weight-loss injection pens from a Chinese passenger arriving from Bangladesh on October 31. The Customs Department reported the arrest on its official Facebook page on November 1. Officials said the pens were found in two suitcases, with the estimated value being more than 5.34 million baht. Santhani Phairattanakorn, an officer at the airport’s passenger inspection office, said the pens contained GLP-1 injections, which are controlled in Thailand as a special-category drug. She said the products were not registered and had no approval from the Food and Drug Administration. Photo via Facebook/ กรมศุลกากร : The Customs Department The department said bringing the items into Thailand violated the Customs Act and the Drug Act. title: 泰警方截获超3万发AK-47步枪子弹 逮捕5名泰柬籍嫌疑人
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，11月2日，泰国中央调查警察局（CIB）下属水警指挥部联合泰国海军情报局，在达叻府Khao Saming县Welu河附近展开行动，抓获5名嫌疑人，其中4人为泰国籍，1人为柬埔寨籍。 警方同时查获多项涉案物品，具体如下： AK-47步枪子弹（7.62毫米）31880发，装在44个铁箱内，每箱装有720发。 AK-47步枪子弹（7.62毫米）200发，以及3根疑似发射药柱的物品。相关物品装在一个铁箱内。疑似发射药柱的物品为绿色PVC管状物，宽约2英寸、长约12英寸。 船只1艘：白色无名、无登记编号的快艇，配备两台本田（HONDA）115马力舷外发动机。 手机2部。 初步讯问中，负责驾驶船只的嫌疑人供称，他受一名男子雇用，对方要求他驾驶船只前往接载柬埔寨籍人员及货物，接载的具体物品是什么，他并不知情。届时会有一艘来自柬埔寨一侧的长尾木船，将人员和货物运送过来。双方约定的接头地点位于达叻府阁骨岛附近的海域中央，处于泰国领海范围内。 完成人员和货物接收后，他需要将船只驶往达叻府考沙明县Welu河沿岸的一处天然码头停靠。随后，执法人员对船只进行检查，并将涉案人员抓获。 （编译：hansa；审核：wan；来源：pptvhd36） The post 泰警方截获超3万发AK-47步枪子弹 逮捕5名泰柬籍嫌疑人 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 泰国歌手JAYLERR与BILLKIN时隔六年再度携手合作，推出全新单曲《Golden Retriever》。歌曲于10月28日正式上线各大音乐平台，官方音乐录影带（MV）也同步在JAYLERR的YouTube官方频道首播。这是JAYLERR个人专辑《JLR》推出的第四支单曲。 两人上一次合作是在六年前。当时，JAYLERR为BILLKIN的歌曲《กอดในใจ》（《心中的拥抱》）担任合作演唱嘉宾，以音乐传递思念与牵挂。此次新作则以更加轻快、活泼的风格，描绘恋爱中的陪伴与依恋，展现两人不同于以往的音乐表达。 《Golden Retriever》由Achariya Dulyapaiboon与Prateep Siriissranan共同创作词曲，融合流行音乐与R&B元素，以轻快的节奏和朗朗上口的旋律，营造出轻松甜蜜的氛围。 歌曲以金毛犬对主人的忠诚与依恋为灵感，将恋爱中的一方比作热情、黏人又毫无保留付出的金毛犬，表达爱上一个人后，即使是平凡的日常，也会因为对方的存在而变得特别。作品通过这一充满亲和力的意象，传递关于陪伴、思念与纯粹情感的主题。 此次MV由泰国电影《天才枪手》导演Baz Nattawut Poonpiriya与新生代MV导演Prang联合执导，在视觉呈现上融入幽默、浪漫与超现实元素。 MV以“金毛系男友”为创意核心。JAYLERR与BILLKIN在宣传视觉中分别穿上浅奶白色和深棕色的金毛犬玩偶服，以夸张可爱的造型呈现角色设定。另一组宣传画面中，JAYLERR手持写有“MISSING YOU SO MUCH”（非常想念你）的手写纸牌，生动呈现恋爱中因思念而产生的情绪。 MV正片则通过一系列生活化场景，展现角色在等待与重逢之间的情绪变化。从主人离开后的失落、独自等待时的落寞，到听见熟悉的声音后瞬间兴奋，以及重逢时难以掩饰的喜悦，作品借鉴金毛犬对主人依恋的行为特征，将恋爱中的思念与亲密感转化为直观的视觉表达。 在镜头设计上，导演将电影感的画面与夸张幽默的表现方式相结合。部分画面采用鱼眼镜头效果，呈现两人在卧室自拍、草地上玩飞盘以及窝在沙发里吃零食等日常场景，营造出轻松随性的氛围。 整体而言，《Golden Retriever》以明快的音乐风格和充满趣味的MV创意，将金毛犬忠诚、热情的特质与恋爱中的陪伴需求相结合。歌曲既延续了JAYLERR与BILLKIN合作时的默契，也通过更加轻松俏皮的表达，为听众带来一首关于亲密关系与纯粹情感的流行作品。 目前，《Golden Retriever》已在Apple Music、Spotify、QQ音乐等音乐平台上线，MV可通过JAYLERR的YouTube官方频道观看。 收听与观看渠道： 歌曲收听： Apple Music、Spotify、QQ音乐等音乐平台 MV观看： YouTube搜索JAY

title: Thai motorists may get cash to scrap ageing vehicles
desc: Thai motorists may get cash to scrap ageing vehicles Legacy Thailand’s Excise Department is seeking 6 billion baht for a pickup trade-in scheme offering 40,000 baht to eligible motorists who scrap older vehicles , aiming to reduce PM2.5 pollution and revive the struggling domestic automotive market . The proposed nationwide programme would support the replacement of 150,000 ageing vehicles with new, locally manufactured pickups or pickup-based passenger vehicles (PPVs). According to Thansettakij, which cited a Finance Ministry source today, November 2, the department has requested funding under the government’s 2026 borrowing programme to begin implementing the scheme in 2027. Under the proposal, only Thai nationals aged 20 or above would qualify. Each participant could surrender one eligible vehicle in exchange for financial assistance towards one new vehicle. The old vehicle must have been registered before 2012 and may be a private passenger car, a passenger vehicle carrying more than seven people or a privately registered goods vehicle. title: Former boy band singer drives pickup into Chai Nat walking street
desc: Former boy band singer drives pickup into Chai Nat walking street Legacy A former member of the boy band group, BKK, drove a pickup truck through a crowded walking street in Chai Nat, injuring three people and damaging vehicles and shops, before leaving the scene. Footage shared on Thai social media showed vendors and visitors on Chai Narong Road in Nai Mueang subdistrict looking on in alarm as the pickup moved through the walking street. Several parked vehicles appeared damaged. Channel 7 reported that the incident happened at about 6.30pm on October 30. The pickup first hit a parked vehicle near the residence of the Chai Nat provincial governor before continuing into the walking street, where it struck visitors and parked vehicles. Three people were injured. Six vehicles were damaged, including one pickup truck, two sedans and three motorcycles. Shops along the street were also damaged. Volunteers from the Ruamkatanyu Foundation took the injured to Chai Nat Narenthorn Hospital. Photo via Matichon The pickup left the scene and was later found at a petrol station about 15 kilometres away. Its front end was badly damaged. The driver was identified as 45 year old former BKK singer Je

title: 中国驻泰国大使馆回应赴泰安全提醒：系预防性保护措施，并非针对泰国
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 中国驻泰国大使馆就近期发布的《提醒赴泰国中国公民提高安全防范意识》作出回应：该提醒属于预防性保护措施，并非针对泰国。使馆方面称，发布提醒的背景是近期有多名中国公民在泰国失踪或受到伤害，相关情况在中国国内社交媒体上引发广泛担忧。 使馆介绍，其每天接到超过十通来自失踪人员家属或滞留在泰中国公民的求助电话，保护本国公民安全与合法权益是使馆无法回避的职责。使馆因此提醒中国公民提高警惕、采取防范措施，避免成为犯罪分子的受害者。 中国驻泰国大使张建卫表示，中方了解这些案件与复杂的跨国犯罪网络有关，并赞赏泰国政府和警方在协助滞留中国公民方面所作的大量努力，以及泰国打击电信诈骗等跨国犯罪的决心和行动。中方愿与泰方进一步加强合作，共同打击跨国犯罪，维护良好旅游氛围和两国民众安全。 他还表示，在双方共同努力下，中泰一定能够共同打击犯罪，为中国游客赴泰旅游安全提供更有力的保障；中方乐见更多中国游客赴泰旅游，同时也欢迎更多泰国游客前往中国。他认为，两国民众密切往来将增进相互理解与友谊，使“中泰一家亲”的情谊代代相传。 （来源：The Nation Thailand） The post 中国驻泰国大使馆回应赴泰安全提醒：系预防性保护措施，并非针对泰国 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 中国驻泰大使馆澄清安全警示：属预防性措施，并非针对泰国
summary_cn: 中国驻泰大使馆就近日发布的赴泰安全提醒作出说明。使馆指出，该提醒属于预防性保护措施，并非针对泰国。近期多名中国公民在泰国失踪或受害，使馆每日接收数十通求助电话。大使张建卫表示，相关案件与跨国犯罪网络有关，中方赞赏泰国政府的配合努力。两国将进一步加强协作，共同打击跨国犯罪，为游客提供更安全的环境，促进「中泰一家亲」的民间往来。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 中国驻泰国大使馆就近期发布的《提醒赴泰国中国公民提高安全防范意识》作出回应：该提醒属于预防性保护措施，并非针对泰国。使馆方面称，发布提醒的背景是近期有多名中国公民在泰国失踪或受到伤害，相关情况在中国国内社交媒体上引发广泛担忧。 使馆介绍，其每天接到超过十通来自失踪人员家属或滞留在泰中国公民的求助电话，保护本国公民安全与合法权益是使馆无法回避的职责。使馆因此提醒中国公民提高警惕、采取防范措施，避免成为犯罪分子的受害者。 中国驻泰国大使张建卫表示，中方了解这些案件与复杂的跨国犯罪网络有关，并赞赏泰国政府和警方在协助滞留中国公民方面所作的大量努力，以及泰国打击电信诈骗等跨国犯罪的决心和行动。中方愿与泰方进一步加强合作，共同打击跨国犯罪，维护良好旅游氛围和两国民众安全。 他还表示，在双方共同努力下，中泰一定能够共同打击犯罪，为中国游客赴泰旅游安全提供更有力的保障；中方乐见更多中国游客赴泰旅游，同时也欢迎更多泰国游客前往中国。他认为，两国民众密切往来将增进相互理解与友谊，使“中泰一家亲”的情谊代代相传。 （来源：The Nation Thailand） The post 中国驻泰国大使馆回应赴泰安全提醒：系预防性保护措施，并非针对泰国 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 从非法减肥针到毒品走私 10月底泰海关非法进口涉案超1252万泰铢
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，泰国总理兼内政部长阿努廷与副总理兼财政部长艾尼提宣布，政府将加快推进海关部门与执法机构的协作，加强执法力度，严厉打击各类非法进口行为，包括走私违禁商品、不符合标准的商品以及毒品等，重点加强对航空口岸、民营快递运输渠道及边境口岸的监管，维护国家经济安全和公众健康。 泰国海关厅厅长潘通与海关系统管控发展顾问南莉素达、海关税收管理发展与行政顾问育塔纳及海关厅副厅长顺丽雅等海关厅高管，已指示各地海关工作人员加强巡查和检查。2026年10月下旬，海关部门共查获4起案件，涉案金额超过1252万泰铢。 10月31日，素万那普机场旅客海关检查办公室主任颂妮透露，海关工作人员在一名从孟加拉国首都达卡抵达泰国的中国籍男性旅客携带的2件行李中发现大量减肥针，共计8900支，估值534万泰铢。上述减肥针属于需要特别管制的药品，涉案人员未经药品登记，也未取得泰国食品药品监督管理局许可，擅自将其带入泰国。其行为涉嫌违反《海关法（2017）》《药品法（2015）》及相关修订法律。海关部门已依法查扣相关物品，并将案件移交进一步处理。 另外，在东北部地区，海关厅第二地区海关办公室主任拉丽达表示，10月29日至31日，第二地区海关办公室联合东北部地区打击犯罪调查部门、警察第二地区调查部门及第一边境巡逻警察部队，对呵叻府境内民营运输公司的货物进行检查。 检查人员发现一批外国来源的香烟，未粘贴消费税税票，也没有合法进口至泰国的相关证明，共计3270条，即65.4万支，涉案金额超过327万泰铢。执法人员已将相关香烟扣押，作为走私货物案件的证据，并将依法追究责任。 在打击跨国毒品走私方面，泰国海关调查与打击犯罪部门负责人埃卡乌迪透露，10月30日，海关调查与打击犯罪部门联合AITF行动小组，对一批从英国运往泰国的紧急进口货物进行检查。该批货物申报为膳食补充剂，具体为必需氨基酸补充剂。 经详细检查，执法人员在补充剂胶囊内发现一类第一类毒品MDMA，总重量为485克，估值约291万泰铢。该批毒品涉嫌未经许可非法进口泰国，违反泰国毒品相关法律及《海关法（2017）》。海关部门已依法查扣货物，并将其移交调查人员，进一步追究法律责任。 在南部边境管控方面，Padang Besar海关口岸关长纳林透露，10月31日，在第四地区海关办公室主任披猜的监督下，Padang Besar海关与泰国陆军第二地区边境巡逻警察部队第5021连联合行动，对从泰马边境进入泰国的私人车辆进行检查。 检查人员在车辆尾部发现6台网络交换机，设备原产地为外国，价值超过100万泰铢。相关物品涉嫌未经海关手续申报而进口，违反《海关法（2017）》第242条及第252条。执法人员已依法扣押设备，并将涉案人员移交巴东勿刹海关进一步处理。 泰国海关部门表示，未来将继续开展持续性执法行动，严厉打击各类非法商品走私活动，同时
title_cn: 泰国海关严打走私 10月查获非法减肥针、毒品等涉案超1252万泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国政府加强海关与执法部门协作，严厉打击非法进口和走私活动。10月下旬，海关在四项执法行动中查获大量违禁品：素万那普机场查出8900支非法减肥针（534万泰铢）；东北部发现65.4万支无消费税票香烟（327万泰铢）；海关调查部门在来自英国的进口货物中查获485克一级毒品MDMA（291万泰铢）；南部边境查获6台走私网络交换机（100万泰铢）。泰国政府表示将继续开展执法，严打各类非法商品走私。
